title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and hybrid reasoning
summary: Anthropic releases Claude 3.7 Sonnet, the first hybrid reasoning model capable of instantaneous responses or extended chain-of-thought reasoning, along with Claude Code preview for terminal workflows.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'hybrid reasoning architecture combining standard generation and extended thinking'

title: Gemini 2.0 Flash is now generally available, plus Gemini 2.0 Pro Experimental
summary: Google announces general availability of Gemini 2.0 Flash with native multimodality, 1M context window, and significantly reduced latency, alongside experimental access to Gemini 2.0 Pro.

title: OpenAI o3-mini: High-efficiency reasoning model for coding and STEM
summary: OpenAI launches o3-mini, offering frontier-class reasoning performance tuned for science, math, and coding tasks with low latency and tiered reasoning effort controls (low, medium, high).
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'frontier reasoning performance at a fraction of o1 latency and cost'

title: DeepSeek-R1 open weights release and reasoning API
summary: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-R1-Zero, open-weight reasoning models trained via pure large-scale reinforcement learning, alongside distilled checkpoints from 1.5B to 70B.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'performance comparable to OpenAI-o1 across math, coding, and reasoning benchmarks'

title: DeepSeek-V3 release: 671B MoE model with multi-head latent attention
summary: DeepSeek launches DeepSeek-V3, a 671B parameter Mixture-of-Experts foundation model (37B active parameters) with open weights, competitive pricing, and 128k context support.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'frontier open-source MoE performance surpassing top open-weights models'

title: OpenAI o1 full release and ChatGPT Plus availability
summary: OpenAI transitions the o1 model series from preview to full release, adding image input modality, improved reasoning speed, and expanded tool use capabilities in API and ChatGPT.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'human-level PhD intelligence benchmark performance'

title: Phi-4: High-capability 14B small language model for complex reasoning
summary: Microsoft Research releases Phi-4, a 14-billion parameter open-weights reasoning model trained on synthetic and curated high-quality datasets, demonstrating exceptional STEM and math reasoning.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'outperforms models multiple times its parameter count on competition mathematics'

title: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct open weights release
summary: Meta releases Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, delivering capability comparable to the previous 405B flagship model at a 70B parameter footprint with permissive community licensing.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'matches the industry's leading closed and open models while running on single-node hardware'

title: GPT-4o-2024-11-20 model checkpoint update
summary: OpenAI deploys an updated GPT-4o snapshot with improved creative writing, natural conversational tone, and enhanced coding problem resolution.

title: Gemini Developer API price reductions and Context Caching expansion
summary: Google announces up to 50% pricing reductions for Gemini 1.5 Pro and 1.5 Flash input tokens alongside expanded context caching availability for developer workloads.

title: Mistral Large 2 (2411) and Pixtral Large release
summary: Mistral releases refreshed Mistral Large 2 (2411) with improved instruction following and Pixtral Large, a 124B parameter frontier multimodal model natively processing high-resolution images.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'frontier visual comprehension with state-of-the-art document and diagram reasoning'

title: xAI API public beta launch with Grok-2 and Grok-2 mini
summary: xAI opens public beta developer access to the xAI API featuring Grok-2 and Grok-2 mini endpoints with vision understanding and real-time knowledge synthesis.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'frontier multimodal understanding and live retrieval'

title: Upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, and Computer Use
summary: Anthropic introduces an upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet showing significant coding improvements, unveils Claude 3.5 Haiku, and releases computer use capabilities in public beta.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'industry-leading software engineering benchmark scores on SWE-bench Verified'

title: Llama 3.2: Multimodal vision models (11B, 90B) and lightweight on-device models (1B, 3B)
summary: Meta releases Llama 3.2, adding visual understanding capabilities to the Llama family with 11B and 90B vision models, plus 1B and 3B lightweight text models optimized for edge devices.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'competitive with closed vision models on image reasoning and chart understanding'

title: Command R+ (08-2024) fine-tuned weights and API deployment
summary: Cohere releases updated Command R+ weights with enhanced multilingual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool-use capabilities across enterprise enterprise workflows.

title: Structured Outputs in the OpenAI API
summary: OpenAI introduces Structured Outputs, guaranteeing 100% adherence to developer-supplied JSON Schemas for gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and subsequent checkpoints.
provider_claims: Provider claim: '100% adherence to supplied JSON Schemas'

title: Llama 3.1 405B, 70B, and 8B open weights release
summary: Meta releases Llama 3.1, introducing the first open-weights flagship model at 405B parameters with 128k context support, alongside refreshed 70B and 8B checkpoints.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'rivals top closed foundation models across general knowledge, steering, reasoning, and math'

title: GPT-4o mini: Cost-efficient frontier multimodal model
summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-4o mini, replacing GPT-3.5 Turbo with superior intelligence, 128k context window, vision support, and over 60% lower pricing.
provider_claims: Provider claim: 'highest-performing small model on MMLU and reasoning benchmarks'
